title: Screen a reading list against four inclusion rules
summary: From a table of papers, count those that meet four inclusion rules and add up their citations.
instructions:
Below is a reading list of papers, one per line, with these fields separated by ' | ': id, year, venue, access and citations.

A paper is included only if all four rules hold:
- it was published in the years 2021 to 2024, both years included;
- its venue name starts with the words Journal of;
- its access is open;
- it has at least 20 citations.

Report two numbers, separated by a comma: how many papers are included, and the total number of citations of the included papers. For example 3,150 means 3 papers with 150 citations between them.

How it is checked: your answer is compared with the correct answer after trimming spaces and ignoring upper or lower case. There is no partial credit, and the reward is paid only for a correct answer.
